elements.label: Figure O.2
elements.title: Countries should match their ambitions with their abilities
elements.content: Chart type: 2x2 matrix/scatter plot representing Ambition of standard (y-axis: Low to High) vs. Compliance capacity (x-axis: Low to High). A dashed diagonal line represents the 'Balanced path of ambition and capacity'. A horizontal dotted line represents 'Minimum standard'. Quadrant annotations: top-left area indicates 'Adapt and build compliance capacity' with arrows pointing towards the balanced path; bottom-left area indicates 'Raise standard and build compliance capacity' with an arrow pointing up-right; bottom-right and right area indicates 'Increase ambition' with an arrow pointing upwards. Source: WDR 2025 team.
